head_commit.message:
ops/ci_provenance_test.py: Review Rescue Checkpoint thu hai (#1322 r1 g2) — c65 thu hep ve dung pham vi dac ta M4/A3, go phep do chay chong va T4

Lop loi-luong-nen-bi-tinh-la-giet-dung tai dien o luot 2-8 (F4..F4g), ca sau khi doi cach lam;
§12 bat dung va xet lai. Dac ta M4/A3 chi doi chot THU TU (thu tu xong dao => dau ra dung thu
tu; as_completed => do) va chot mien M1, KHONG doi phep do chay chong. Phep do chay chong (luong
phu -> Barrier -> cau hinh pool, dot bien T4) do g1 them ngoai dac ta va la noi lop F4 song.
Go: Barrier, ghi_cau_hinh, HAN_CHONG_C65, T4. Giu: _thu_tu_tat_dinh (F1), phep n=1, M1, F2, F3.
F4g (luot 8) khong va: be mat cua no da go. Quyet dinh ghi so uy quyen ADR-0067,
issuecomment-7046235668.
